issues.title: Orphan cleanup also deletes gift-card rows
issues.explanation: For a NULL order_id the subquery finds no order, so NOT EXISTS is true and every gift-card top-up is deleted. The foreign key itself allows NULLs; only the cleanup is wrong.
issues.fix: Add AND oi.order_id IS NOT NULL to the DELETE.

issues.title: Missing ON DELETE CASCADE
issues.explanation: DB-310 asks for deleting an order to delete its items. The default is NO ACTION, so deleting an order that has items now fails instead.

issues.title: VALIDATE runs in the same transaction as ADD
issues.explanation: NOT VALID only helps if validation happens later. Here the SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE locks taken by ADD CONSTRAINT on order_items and orders are held until commit, i.e. through the full 120M-row validation scan (and the orphan DELETE before it), blocking writes far longer than a few seconds.
issues.fix: Commit the NOT VALID constraint in one migration and run VALIDATE CONSTRAINT in a separate one.

issues.title: No index on order_items.order_id
issues.explanation: Postgres does not index the referencing column. With ON DELETE CASCADE every order delete scans the 120M-row order_items table to find children.
issues.fix: First add CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY ON order_items (order_id) in its own non-transactional migration.
